notes.title: More languages have been added!
notes.notes:
Hi friends,

With this update, there have been 3 more languages added. 
From now [h1]Italian, Spanish and Portuguese-Brazil[/h1] are available on Steam!

Have fun playing "Darkness and Flame: Born of Fire"!
